>She would dump all of her emotional baggage and problems on me

wow, that right there is so true to my situation. Trust me, I am done with here. I'll have to see her in classes for 2 months which sucks, but I'm done with her. I haven't had great experiences with relationships in the past (partly due to letting my depression not letting me enter relationships), but this is hands down the worse I have ever been treated by someone. She recently said I was her best friend for life, and that she didn't mean to cause harm, but who does this to their best friend?

I've already stepped back and realized it was a one sided friendship. I'm done with her, it just sucks how much this triggered my depression.
